$comment: M2. A Cowrie pack bought with a slow payment method, so Google Play reports it PENDING (ADR-0028; contracts/v1/state-machines/meet_play_purchase.json transitions 1-4). Nothing is credited until Play says PURCHASED; the server then grants, consumes and tells the app. The purchase token below is a placeholder, not the shape of a real one. M2-PR5 and M2-PR6 implement it.

mock_store_product_details.note: What MockStoreBillingService returns. The app shows ProductDetails.price verbatim and never builds a price; no naira figure is hard-coded anywhere

buy.call: buyConsumable with GooglePlayPurchaseParam(applicationUserName: billing_account_ref) and autoConsume: false
buy.note: billing_account_ref is minted by the server, 32 hex characters, never an email, phone number or user id. autoConsume false keeps the client from consuming before the server grants.

verify_pending.show: A 'Payment pending' row on the Cowries page, from the purchase stream. Nothing is credited and nothing should look credited.

later_granted.how: Play reports PURCHASED by RTDN; the server verifies, grants 520 to purchased, consumes, and broadcasts meet.wallet {version} on user:{uid}. On the next resume the app's restorePurchases posts the token again and gets the stored result.
later_granted.then: completePurchase, which is expected to be a no-op because the server already consumed (spike S-15 confirms).

queued.note: Play could not be reached, or verification is paused. The worker retries for up to 48 hours; nothing for the app to do but refresh later.

rejected.note: Never granted. If it was paid for, the worker refunds and revokes it at Play, so nobody pays for nothing. The HTTP status is illustrative until edge-functions.openapi.yaml lists the function (M2-PR6).

never_trusted: reported_price_micros and reported_currency are recorded for information only; nothing that grants reads them.

errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_REJECTED: A check failed: wrong package, not purchased, account mismatch or a purchase hold.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_TOKEN_CLAIMED: The token is bound to another account.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PRODUCT_UNKNOWN: The product is not an active pack or meet_vip.
